competing_hypotheses.claim: The five Binance-labelled XRPL accounts transferred exactly 233,461,943.1 native XRP to one newly activated receiver within 4 minutes 20 seconds.
support: Five Bithomp transaction pages show successful validated payments and exact source, destination, amount, hash and ledger index.
The exact sum matches TRM's 233.46M and Bitquery's approximately 233.5M.
counter: Bithomp is one explorer provider; raw validated-ledger transactions are the underlying evidence.
The exact October 1 PoR membership of these wallets remains unknown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The attacker receiver still holds the full 233.4619431M XRP at the Bithomp page capture; no sale is evidenced in the captured transaction list.
support: Five incoming payments and one unrelated XGO Check appear; no outgoing XRP payment is listed.
counter: Page capture is a point-in-time explorer view; later transactions may occur or indexing may lag.
No sale is established only through the captured state, not for all future time.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The five source wallets form a common Binance-labelled operational cluster.
support: All five are labelled Binance by Bithomp.
Four other accounts show activation by central account rDAE53, itself Binance-labelled.
counter: Bithomp labels and activation history are third-party attribution, not Binance's signed PoR statement.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The stolen 233.46M XRP may impair Binance's XRP reserve coverage if these wallets were in the October 1 PoR set.
support: Five Binance-labelled source wallets lost exactly 233.46M XRP.
Secondary October 1 reporting shows XRP reserve ratio 100.77%.
counter: No official PoR address crosswalk has been completed.
No XRP-BF2 backing-wallet relationship is established.
Binance says it will cover losses; post-incident replenishment not measured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The $902.3M XRPL transfer-volume metric substantially overstates executed trading/capital activity if misread as turnover.
support: Bithomp reports $902.3M transfer volume versus $13.07M DEX volume, a ratio of approximately 69x.
DEX buy/sell volumes are nearly balanced at $6.50M/$6.57M.
counter: DEX volume excludes centralized exchange, OTC and other settlement activity; it is not total market trading.
